en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā’īl ibn ‘Isā, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Amr Al-Zayyāt, from Kirām (‘Abdil Karīm Al-Khath’ami), from Ismā’īl ibn Jābir, who said:
I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: Verily Ḥusain (a.s.) was killed in anguish. Therefore, it is only fitting that Allāh sends back every anguished person who comes to his Ziyārah pleased.
